'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Thomas Nobe DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Nobe]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' It's Worse Than My Lightsaber?
* '''Username:''' Brutstick?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
